what: The same text is stacked in two layers. On hover the top layer fades out while moving up half a line (−.5em) over .3s ease-in-out, and the bottom layer rises from half a line below over .3s and sharpens by .4s. On leave it snaps straight back with no transition (the original applied the transition to the entering state only). If you come back within .4s of leaving, it waits out that time before switching — so scanning across a menu doesn’t stutter

options.look: soft: Only the leaving layer rises −.2em, both at .3s (original tail link)
options.hold: Seconds before accepting input again after exit, default .4
options.--fx-shift · --fx-shift-out · --fx-dur ·: Distance, length, second-layer position (CSS variable, the original menu uses --fx-top: −2px)
options.[data-fx-part=twin]: Second layer (if none, duplicated from label)

from.where: shared.js .r-nav a·.r-foot a — hv-tgl first/second (.3s · .4s ease-in-out, head −.5em · tail −.2em)
